description: Analyzes protein structures from PDB files: parses ATOM/HETATM records with a dependency-free pure-Python parser, computes radius of gyration, gyration tensor and dipole moments, assigns secondary structure via DSSP or a built-in Kabsch-Sander hydrogen-bond implementation, and optionally retrieves UniProt metadata. This skill should be used when secondary structure assignment, Rg, shape analysis, DSSP, PDB parsing or protein structure annotation is requested.
